posts.title: cgit as an Unintentional Honeypot
posts.description: On a whim, I recently migrated all of my Git repositories to a cgit instance on WIREDNET . It's caused some headaches because the server-side rendering can be quite resource intensive. Mere minutes after setting it up, the fans on my server spun up because the repos were being scraped by ClaudeBot and friends.
